//: Composite index manifest. Before this file existed every prod index was created by hand from a console error link, and there was no record of which ones existed. The Firestore EMULATOR DOES NOT ENFORCE composite indexes, so a query that runs fine locally can fail with FAILED_PRECONDITION in production -- run `dotnet run --project backend/FantasyWarrior.Jobs -- check-indexes` against real Firestore to verify, not the emulator. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
